tags.summary: A line in or notation on the image that gives out a [[Twitter]] account (usually one belonging to the artist). May be used as an alternative to [[signature|signing]] the image if the [[artist_name|name]] is associated with a profile of the artist. May also be a [[Pawoo username]] or other username;
tags.wiki_zh: 图像上的一行文字或标注，给出了 [[Twitter]] 账号（通常为画师本人的账号）。 可作为对图像 [[signature|signing]] 的替代，如果 [[artist_name|name]] 与画师的个人资料相关联。也可能是 [[Pawoo username]] 或其他用户名；应核对画师条目以匹配其个人资料。 示例 另见 [[signature]] [[watermark]] [[web address]] [[Tag group:Text]]

tags.name: streaked_hair
tags.summary: [[Multicolored hair]] or [[two-tone hair]] where the majority of the hair is one color, while only one or multiple small streaks possess a different color or colors. Examples Related tags Colors [[aqua streaks]] [[black streaks]] [[blonde streaks]] [[blue streaks]] [[brown streaks]]
tags.wiki_zh: [[Multicolored hair]] 或 [[two-tone hair]] ，指大部分头发为一种颜色，仅有一束或多束小范围发束呈现不同颜色。 示例 相关标签 颜色 [[aqua streaks]] [[black streaks]] [[blonde streaks]] [[blue streaks]] [[brown streaks]] [[green streaks]] [[grey streaks]] [[orange streaks]] [[pink streaks]] [[purple streaks]] [[red streaks]] [[white streaks]] 另见 [[single hair streak]] [[colored tips]] [[Tag group:Hair color]]

tags.name: blunt_bangs
tags.summary: A hairstyle where the [[bangs]] are cut in a sharp, straight line across the entire length of the forehead. Mutually exclusive with [[swept bangs]] and [[asymmetrical bangs]] . Known in Japan as パッツン (pattsun). When combined with [[long hair]] and blunt [[sidelocks]] , it becomes a type of
tags.wiki_zh: 一种发型，指 [[bangs]] 在整个额头的宽度范围内被剪成一条利落、笔直的直线。与 [[swept bangs]] 和 [[asymmetrical bangs]] 互斥。 在日本被称为パッツン（pattsun）。 当与 [[long hair]] 和钝感的 [[sidelocks]] 组合时，会形成一种 [[hime cut]] 。如果刘海在鬓角处被剃掉或向后梳起，而其余部分仍松散地垂在额前，则可能会形成 [[center-flap bangs]] 。 示例 另请参见 [[arched bangs]] [[blunt ends]] [[bangs]] [[swept bangs]] - 指松散地梳向一侧的刘海 [[parted bangs]] - 指有明显分缝的刘海 [[double-parted bangs]] [[asymmetrical bangs]] - 指一半向后梳起、一半散落的刘海 [[crossed bangs]] - 指在额头上相互交叉的刘海 [[hair over eyes]] - 指遮住眼睛的长刘海 [[hair over one eye]] - 与上述相同，但为不对称式 [[fanged bangs]] - 指刘海边缘较长的发绺（最常与齐刘海搭配）

tags.name: pink_eyes
tags.summary: A character with pink colored eyes. Due to the subjective nature of color judgment and other factors (such as the lighting on the characters), there is an overlap between this tag and the [[purple eyes]] and [[red eyes]] tags. Examples See also [[Tag group:Eyes tags]]
tags.wiki_zh: 拥有粉色眼睛的角色。 由于颜色判断的主观性及其他因素（如角色所处的光照等），本标签与 [[purple eyes]] 和 [[red eyes]] 标签存在重叠。 示例 另请参见 [[Tag group:Eyes tags]]

tags.name: tongue_out
tags.summary: Sticking the [[tongue]] out past the entrance of the mouth. The mouth may be [[open mouth|open]] or [[closed mouth|closed]] , and the tongue may be lolling out or intentionally jutting out. Examples [[Licking lips]] [[:p]] [[;p]] [[:q]] [[;q]] [[Akanbe]] See also [[:P]] [[;P]] [[:q]] [[;q]]
tags.wiki_zh: 将 [[tongue]] 伸出口外。嘴巴可以是 [[open mouth|open]] 或 [[closed mouth|closed]] ，舌头可能是无力地耷拉出来，也可能是有意地向外伸出。 例子 [[Licking lips]] [[:p]] [[;p]] [[:q]] [[;q]] [[Akanbe]] 另见 [[:P]] [[;P]] [[:q]] [[;q]] [[akanbe]] （一边拉下单侧眼睑一边吐舌的姿势） [[ahegao]] [[licking lips]] [[tehepero]]

tags.wiki_zh: [[Holding]] 任意类型的 [[weapon]] 。 对于最常见的武器类型，有以下一些标签： [[holding axe]] [[holding baton (weapon)]] [[holding bow (weapon)]] [[holding chakram]] [[holding club]] [[holding crossbow]] [[holding dagger]] [[holding energy gun]] [[holding flail]] [[holding flamethrower]] [[holding grenade]] [[holding gun]] [[holding kunai]] [[holding mace]] [[holding nunchaku]] [[holding polearm]] [[holding rocket launcher]] [[holding shuriken]] [[holding slingshot]] [[holding sword]] 其他武器可以通过组合标签搜索找到： {{holding_weapon battle_axe}} {{holding_weapon mace}} {{holding_weapon club_(weapon)}} {{holding_sword katana}} {{holding_gun rifle}} 示例 [[holding sword]] [[holding gun]] [[holding bow (weapon)]] 另见 [[left-handed]] [[two-handed]] [[half-swording]] [[reverse grip]] [[between fingers]] [[dual wielding]]

tags.name: stomach
tags.summary: The frontal abdomen, specifically the area around the [[navel]] and above the [[groin]] . Should only be used when the stomach is a prominent, noticeable part of the image, not merely in the background or partially exposed. See [[belly]] or [[big belly]] for a large or plump stomach. See [[midriff]]
tags.wiki_zh: 正面的腹部，特指 [[navel]] 周围、 [[groin]] 上方的区域。 仅当腹部作为画面中突出、显眼的部分时才应使用此标签，而不仅仅是处于背景中或部分露出时。 大而圆润/丰满的腹部请参见 [[belly]] 或 [[big belly]] 。因衣物过短而使腹部部分外露的情况请参见 [[midriff]] 。指代体内器官时请参见 [[stomach (organ)]] 。 示例 [[Midriff]] [[Big belly]] 相关标签 解剖 [[abs]] [[midriff]] [[navel]] [[no navel]] [[obliques]] [[stomach focus]] [[stomach (organ)]] 形状与状态 [[belly]] [[big belly]] [[bouncing belly]] [[bursting belly]] [[full stomach]] [[pregnant]] [[stomach bulge]] [[veiny belly]] [[veiny stomach]] 服装与配饰 [[belly chain]] [[navel piercing]] [[stomach cutout]] [[stomach jewel]] [[stomach piercing]] 纹样与物件 [[bandaid on stomach]] [[bandaged stomach]] [[bite mark on stomach]] [[blood on stomach]] [[bruise on stomach]] [[chocolate on stomach]] [[lipstick mark on stomach]] [[mole on stomach]] [[scar on stomach]]

tags.name: sailor_collar
tags.summary: A sailor-style collar, a two-color collar (usually blue and white or black and white) with one or more stripes near its edges. Often worn with a [[serafuku]] and paired with a [[neckerchief]] . Examples Related tags Colors [[Aqua sailor collar]] [[Black sailor collar]] [[Blue sailor collar]]
tags.wiki_zh: 一种水手风格的领子，双色领子（通常为蓝白或黑白），边缘附近有一条或多条条纹。常与 [[serafuku]] 搭配穿着，并与 [[neckerchief]] 成套。 示例 相关标签 颜色 [[Aqua sailor collar]] [[Black sailor collar]] [[Blue sailor collar]] [[Brown sailor collar]] [[Green sailor collar]] [[Grey sailor collar]] [[Orange sailor collar]] [[Pink sailor collar]] [[Purple sailor collar]] [[Red sailor collar]] [[White sailor collar]] [[Yellow sailor collar]] [[Gradient sailor collar]] [[Multicolored sailor collar]] 设计 [[Frilled sailor collar]] [[Fur-trimmed sailor collar]] [[Lace-trimmed sailor collar]] [[Transparent sailor collar]] 图案 [[Argyle sailor collar]] [[Camouflage sailor collar]] [[Gingham sailor collar]] [[Print sailor collar]] 动作/状态 [[Naked sailor collar]] [[Sailor collar lift]] [[Unworn sailor collar]] 另见 [[collared shirt]] [[serafuku]] [[sailor dress]]

tags.name: elbow_gloves
tags.summary: [[Gloves]] that extend past the elbow to the upper arm, sometimes reaching all the way to the shoulder/armpit. If the gloves end bellow the elbow use [[under-elbow gloves]] instead. Gloves worn with formal dresses such as [[evening gown]] s and [[cocktail dress]] es are often known as evening gloves
tags.wiki_zh: 延伸超过肘部至上臂的 [[Gloves]] ，有时甚至一直延伸到肩膀/腋下。如果手套在肘部以下结束，请改用 [[under-elbow gloves]] 。 与 [[evening gown]] 和 [[cocktail dress]] 等正装礼服搭配佩戴的手套通常被称为晚礼服手套，其中延伸超过肘部的晚礼服手套被称为歌剧手套。 示例 歌剧手套 错误示例 [[under-elbow gloves]] 另见 [[under-elbow gloves]] [[arm garter]] [[bridal gauntlets]] [[detached sleeves]] [[single elbow glove]]

tags.wiki_zh: 头上长有猫耳，或将其作为时尚配饰佩戴在头上的角色（nekomimi）。 请勿将此标签用于真正的 [[cat]] 。 示例 另见 [[cat]] [[cat girl]] [[cat hat]] / [[cat hood]] [[cat tail]] [[cat ear hairband]] [[tiger ears]] [[Tag Group:Body parts]]

E

tags.name: dark_skin
tags.summary: Skin that is darker in tone than the usual Eurasian skin tone. Characters usually have this skin tone naturally, but sometimes have dark skin due to a [[tan]] , alternate coloring, etc. Examples [[Dark-skinned female]] [[Dark-skinned male]] [[Very dark skin]] See also [[dark-skinned female]]
tags.wiki_zh: 比常见的欧亚人肤色更深的肤色。角色通常天生就是这种肤色，但有时也会因 [[tan]] 、另类配色等原因而呈现深色皮肤。 示例 [[Dark-skinned female]] [[Dark-skinned male]] [[Very dark skin]] 另见 [[dark-skinned female]] [[dark-skinned male]] [[very dark skin]] [[tan]] [[pale skin]] [[Tag group:Skin color]]

tags.name: midriff
tags.summary: When the [[stomach]] is left partially exposed by clothing. The midriff is the region of the body between the chest and the waist. Use this tag when the midriff is left bare by clothing too short to cover the stomach, e.g. a [[crop top]] and [[pants]] . The stomach shouldn't be exposed much more tha
tags.wiki_zh: 当 [[stomach]] 因服装而部分露出时。 中腹是指胸部与腰部之间的身体区域。当因服装过短无法遮住腹部而导致中腹裸露时使用此标签，例如 [[crop top]] 和 [[pants]] 。腹部裸露的高度不应远超过 [[navel]] 的高度，不过为了搭配{{high-waist_*|高腰服装}}时可以更高一些。 不要将此标签用作 [[stomach]] 标签的替代，也不要在腹部完全暴露时使用。这包括角色处于 [[nude]] 、上身赤裸、 [[bottomless]] 、仅穿着 [[bikini]] 或 [[underwear]] ，或是看不到下装的情况。该标签可用于作为外穿穿着的内衣，例如 [[sports bra]] 、 [[camisole]] 、与内裤搭配穿着的 [[tank top]] 等。 示例 非示例 另见 [[Crop top]] [[Crop top overhang]] [[Cropped jacket]] [[Cropped shirt]] [[Midriff peek]]

tags.name: two-tone_hair
tags.summary: [[Multicolored hair]] that consists of two distinct colors. The division between the two colors may be an immediate change from one to the other or it may be done in a gradient, in which case the [[gradient hair]] tag would also apply. If a character has two hair colors that are split vertically at
tags.wiki_zh: 由两种截然不同的颜色构成的 [[Multicolored hair]] 。 两种颜色之间的分界可能是直接的 abrupt 切换，也可能是通过渐变来过渡，在后一种情况下也会同时适用 [[gradient hair]] 标签。 如果角色的两种发色在头顶处垂直分开，并垂落下来形成两个截然不同的区域，则也会同时适用 [[split-color hair]] 标签。 示例 另见 [[Colored inner hair]] [[Colored tips]] [[Multicolored hair]] [[Split-color hair]] [[Streaked hair]] [[Tag group:Hair color]]

tags.name: hair_flower
tags.summary: One or more [[flower]] s, living or artificial, being worn as a [[hair ornament]] . If the flowers encircle the character's entire head, it's a [[head wreath]] instead. If the flower is attached to a [[hairband]] , it's [[flower hairband]] . Examples See also [[hair petal]] [[flower in braid]]
tags.wiki_zh: 一朵或多朵 [[flower]] （鲜花或人造花）作为 [[hair ornament]] 佩戴。如果花环绕角色的整个头部，则应标为 [[head wreath]] 。 如果花是固定在 [[hairband]] 上的，则为 [[flower hairband]] 。 示例 另见 [[hair petal]] [[flower in braid]] [[flower_on_head|flower on head]] [[flower-shaped hair]] [[Tsumami kanzashi]] [[plant_on_head|plant on head]]

tags.name: cloud
tags.summary: A cloud is a mass of water vapor that floats in the [[sky]] . Examples [[cumulonimbus cloud]] See also [[cloud focus]] [[cloudy sky]] , a sky mostly filled with clouds [[dust cloud]] [[overcast]] , a sky completely covered with clouds [[dark cloud]] [[above clouds]] [[shaped cloud]] , a cloud that t
tags.wiki_zh: 云是由漂浮在 [[sky]] 中的水蒸气聚集而成的团块。 示例 [[cumulonimbus cloud]] 另见 [[cloud focus]] [[cloudy sky]] ，大部分天空被云覆盖 [[dust cloud]] [[overcast]] ，天空完全被云覆盖 [[dark cloud]] [[above clouds]] [[shaped cloud]] ，呈现出某种物体形状（通常是动物或物体）的云 [[cumulonimbus cloud]] ，浓厚高耸的垂直云体 [[fallstreak hole]] ，卷积云或高积云中的大片空洞 [[egasumi]] ，一种程式化的传统日式云纹图案 [[xiangyun]] ，一种带有漩涡纹样的传统云彩程式化表现手法 [[contrail]] ，飞机产生的云状尾迹 [[distrail]] ，飞机在云层中留下的空白轨迹 [[flying nimbus]] ，作为交通工具使用的魔法云

tags.name: serafuku
tags.summary: The [[school uniform]] with a [[sailor collar|sailor-style collar]] worn by Japanese schoolgirls in middle school and high school. The standard uniform consists of a white [[blouse]] , a [[pleated skirt]] , and a red [[neckerchief]] , but there are as many variations as there are stars in the sky. S
tags.wiki_zh: [[school uniform]] ，指日本中学和高中女生穿着的、带有 [[sailor collar|sailor-style collar]] 的服装。标准的制服由白色 [[blouse]] 、 [[pleated skirt]] 和红色 [[neckerchief]] 组成，但其变体多如繁星。 水手服通常会搭配 [[ribbon]] 或 [[bow]] 来代替传统的领巾。“领巾”和“蝴蝶结”之间的界限很模糊，因为与水手服搭配的蝴蝶结往往并非专门的蝴蝶结或 [[bowtie|bowties]] ，而是将领巾系成蝴蝶结的形状，而非其原本的围巾状。 一套水手服必定包含 [[skirt]] 。如果水手风格的上衣搭配短裤或其他下装，则应使用 [[sailor shirt]] 来代替。事实上，搭配短裤的水手服才是更古老、更原始的样式：在维多利亚时代和爱德华时代，它们被用作男童服装，之后才衍生出搭配裙子的女生制服。 对于带颜色的水手服标签， [[shirt]] 和 [[skirt]] 的颜色必须一致才可适用，但领饰或 [[sailor collar]] 则无需一致。 [[Sailor dress]] 不应被标记为水手服。 示例 [[Summer uniform]] [[Winter uniform]] [[white serafuku]] 衬衫和裙子必须为白色。 颜色 [[aqua serafuku]] [[black serafuku]] [[blue serafuku]] [[brown serafuku]] [[green serafuku]] [[grey serafuku]] [[orange serafuku]] [[pink serafuku]] [[purple serafuku]] [[red serafuku]] [[white serafuku]]

tags.wiki_zh: 一件 [[jacket]] ，其颜色为 [[black]] 。 示例 另见 [[black coat]] [[Tag group:Attire]]

tags.name: sparkle
tags.summary: A momentary bright shimmer of reflected [[light]] , generally [[diamond_(shape)|]] -, astroid or [[star (symbol)|]] -shaped, and short-lived.
